listings.title: Royal Manhattan

listings.summary: Royal Manhattan is a fully furnished, resort-style residence at School Junction in Ashale Botwe. The four en-suite bedrooms, private pool, and premium finishes make this one of the most complete turnkey homes available in greater Accra at this price point.
listings.summary2: Minutes from the East Legon commercial corridor, international schools, and the ring road, the location balances prestige with everyday convenience.
listings.verifiedSummary: Title searched at the Lands Commission and independently surveyed before listing.

listings.summary: Beverly Homes is a statement residence in the prestigious Beverly Hills enclave of East Legon. The fully furnished four-bedroom home is designed for those who entertain — a fully equipped outdoor kitchen, manicured garden terrace, and open-plan living areas set this apart from comparable homes in the neighbourhood.
listings.summary2: East Legon's finest restaurants, international schools, and the Accra Mall are all within a five-minute drive.
listings.verifiedSummary: Title searched at the Lands Commission and independently surveyed before listing.

listings.summary: Westland Residence is an elegant four-bedroom home in Westland, Accra — a quiet, established address increasingly preferred by professionals and returning diaspora. The home includes a private study, covered pergola terrace, and semi-furnished interiors that give the new owner room to personalise.
listings.summary2: The layout blends formal and informal living spaces thoughtfully, with a generous garden and double garage completing the offering.

listings.summary: Cantonments Court is a contemporary three-bedroom development in Cantonments — one of Accra's most prestigious and diplomatically active addresses. Currently under construction with a Q4 2026 handover, early reservations are being accepted at the introductory off-plan pricing.
listings.summary2: The development features three en-suite bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, and a high-specification finish programme. Cantonments' central location puts the Accra CBD, Ridge, and Osu all within minutes.
listings.verifiedSummary: Title searched at the Lands Commission before launch.

listings.title: Airport Residential Loft
listings.photosTodo: TODO(sam): supply real photos for Airport Residential Loft. The old page used an Unsplash stock photo, now replaced with the branded placeholder.
listings.summary: The Airport Residential Loft is a fully furnished two-bedroom luxury apartment in one of Accra's most internationally connected addresses. Ideal for expats, executives on rotation, or anyone seeking a high-quality, move-in-ready rental in a quiet, secure neighbourhood.
listings.summary2: The loft features clean contemporary finishes, a rooftop terrace, 24-hour security, and concierge support. Airport Residential puts Kotoka International Airport, the CBD, and Cantonments all within a short drive.
